description.value: SAKU is a Japanese katsu restaurant chain that introduced traditional breaded-and-fried cutlets to Vancouver when it opened its first Robson Street location in early 2018. The Richmond branch is one of several Lower Mainland outposts operated under the LLH Eatery parent company, specialising in premium-quality meats served in the katsu style. Walk-ins join a digital waitlist rather than booking a table in advance.
